title: The Works: tier 5, The wire
lines: Tier 5 is open. Copper comes from salvage, on the new land. A breaker turns salvage into copper, ingots, glass, slag and gears, mixed on one belt. The depot does not take slag.
Breakers make smog on the plot they stand on. The ground clears 300 a minute and each redwood 120. A plot with too much slows every machine on it.

more.head: New
points: A mill makes wire from copper and gravel from slag.
Coils, bulbs, telegraphs, strings of lights and the Spark folio.
A redwood's card says what it clears. Felling one loses that for good.

more.head: Also
points: Shelves for the plan chest keep blueprints of up to 40 by 25 tiles, so all 1,000 pieces fit.
